project_reference.core_research_question: Can typed absence, explicit provenance, and recoverable compaction prevent silent state loss in real long-running autonomous agents?
project_reference.current_focus: v2.0 — The Forgetting Agent: close validation gaps with genuine compaction, diverse workloads, and cross-architecture testing

scope.question: Can typed absence, explicit provenance, and recoverable compaction prevent silent state loss in real long-running autonomous agents?
in_scope: Instrument Zarathustra/OpenClaw with forge tools on real mixed autonomous workflows
Measure violation detection on naturally-occurring failures
Measure provenance survival through real context-window compaction
Compare against uninstrumented Zarathustra baseline and MockLM anchor results
Formalize the null ontology with 8 canonical absence states and state-transition rules
Establish fresh uninstrumented Zarathustra baseline on same task set
out_of_scope: General semantic truth in AI systems
Porting to third-party runtimes (RQ4 generality deferred)
unresolved_questions: What specific real tasks constitute a sufficient stress test for compaction?
Should timed_out and interrupted be distinct absence states?
Should recoverability be binary or graded?

user_asserted_anchors: MockLM experiment anchor: 100 percent provenance reachability, six of six violations caught, trace size about 87 percent smaller than vanilla logging (compression_ratio about 1.096x, per corrected Convention 7)
Uninstrumented Zarathustra baseline established in Phase 2 (see baseline report under data baselines)
known_good_baselines: MockLM experiment results as cross-reference anchor
context_gaps: Uninstrumented Zarathustra baseline not yet measured
Specific real-task corpus for stress testing not yet defined
crucial_inputs: Violation detection is the primary success signal, not provenance scores
Must catch at least one naturally-occurring silent failure, not just injected ones
Must survive real context-window compaction, not just mock scenarios

formulations: Typed absence ontology with 8 canonical states
forbidden_estimator_families: Self-report from the system as evidence
stop_and_rethink_conditions: Typed absence adds complexity without measurable reliability gains
Provenance chains fail under realistic recursive or compacted workloads
Compaction grounding proves too brittle to preserve meaningful return paths

observables.name: Naturally-occurring silent failure detection
observables.definition: Count of real (not injected) silent failures detected by forge instrumentation on Zarathustra real tasks

observables.name: Provenance survival through real compaction
observables.definition: Provenance reachability fraction after real context-window compaction events

observables.name: Trace compression ratio
observables.definition: Size ratio of forge-compressed traces vs vanilla logger payloads on real tasks

claims.statement: Forge instrumentation detects structural failures on real agent tasks that go undetected without it
Provenance chains survive real context-window compaction with measurable reachability

deliverables.description: Report documenting naturally-occurring silent failures detected by forge on real Zarathustra tasks
must_contain: At least one naturally-occurring failure detection

deliverables.description: Report documenting provenance reachability after real context-window compaction
Formalized null ontology with state-transition matrix, validator rules, and example traces
Uninstrumented Zarathustra baseline measurements on the same task set

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-violation-detection
acceptance_tests.procedure: Run Zarathustra with forge on mixed autonomous tasks long enough to trigger real compaction. Check if forge flags at least one structural violation that uninstrumented run missed.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: At least 1 naturally-occurring violation detected that uninstrumented baseline missed

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-compaction-survival
acceptance_tests.procedure: After real compaction events, measure provenance reachability. Compare against MockLM anchor (100%).
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Provenance reachability measured and gaps explained; violation detection remains functional post-compaction

references.why_it_matters: Establishes the ceiling under controlled conditions: 100 percent provenance reachability, six of six violations detected, traces about 87 percent smaller than vanilla logging (compression_ratio about 1.096x, per corrected Convention 7)

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-compaction-survival
forbidden_proxies.proxy: All tests pass but only on short tasks that never trigger real compaction
forbidden_proxies.reason: Compaction survival is untested if compaction never fires

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-compaction-survival
forbidden_proxies.proxy: High provenance scores on shallow traces where nothing interesting was pruned
forbidden_proxies.reason: Trivial traces do not stress the provenance protocol

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-violation-detection
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Violation detection on synthetic/injected faults only with no naturally-occurring detections
forbidden_proxies.reason: Catching injected faults proves the mechanism works but not that real failures exist and are caught

weakest_anchors: Compaction under real context pressure — MockLM never hit genuine memory limits
unvalidated_assumptions: Eight canonical absence states are sufficient to cover real agent runtime states
Forge tools designed for MockLM integrate cleanly into Zarathustra agent loop
competing_explanations: Silent failures might be too rare in Zarathustra to surface within a reasonable test campaign
disconfirming_observations: Forge instrumentation adds latency or complexity that degrades agent performance without catching real failures
Provenance chains break systematically under real compaction despite working perfectly on mocks

decisions.summary: CC-014: Multi-architecture validation required for PhD-level generality claim
CC-015: Reframe detection → prevention if 0 natural violations persist on 200+ diverse runs — **TRIGGERED** (0/211 on mock backend)
CC-016: Semantic Provenance Fidelity (SPF) as new metric class bridging structural/semantic gap
CC-017: D4 detection requires 4 heuristics (self-ref, forward-ref, cross-type, gap) for 100% on injected faults
CC-018: D7 detection requires external tool_call_log; cannot be detected from chamber structure alone
CC-019: Empty strings are present output (not absent) — adapter wraps to sentinel for forge compliance
CC-020: Reversibility uses root-node reachability; ForgeCheckpointSaver wrapping pattern validated for graph-based architectures
CC-021: RQ4 verdict POSITIVE (pipeline-validated, pending live validation) — forge guarantees transfer across 3 architecture types

custom_conventions.semantic_provenance_fidelity: embedding cosine similarity between original and recovered artifacts
custom_conventions.cross_architecture_metrics: same definitions across frameworks, architectural differences documented

blockers: SWE-Bench setup requirements unknown (need research agent output)
Agent framework API stability uncertain (LangGraph/CrewAI evolve rapidly)
